title: Guy's Better Leather
description: Makes saddles craftable and adds new ways of obtaining leather from things like rotten flesh.
body:
Guy's Better Leather Datapack | This datapack makes leather a little more useful and makes it easier to get. 

**Features**
- Backports the saddle recipe from 1.21.6 to 1.20-1.21.1
- You can now break down the saddle back into leather.
- Makes rotten flesh able to be smelted into leather in a furnace.
- Makes rotten flesh able to be cooked into leather on a campfire.
  
  More features for future versions soon...
